data.name: Gabriella
data.gender_notes: Gabriella is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Feminine of Gabriel, from the Hebrew gavri, 'my strength', + El, 'God'. Its root is Hebrew g-b-r-ʾ-l. The archangel Gabriel (Luke 1:19). Gabriella is a Hebrew name meaning “God is my strength”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Gabriella expresses “God is my strength”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: Feminine of Gabriel, from the Hebrew gavri, 'my strength', + El, 'God'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gabriella total 40, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.
